# PODFY

> Proof of delivery platform for carriers, 3PLs, shippers, and logistics teams. GPS-stamped photo POD without a driver app. EU-hosted (Cloudflare EU jurisdiction). Built for Dutch and Belgian logistics operations.

Full guide text for ingestion: https://podfy.net/llms-full.txt

## Pricing

PODFY is priced per processed POD (proof of delivery). No monthly seat fees,
no per-user charges, no setup costs. Plans differ by retention period and
included features.

### Plans (per POD processed, excl. VAT)

| Plan       | Rate    | Retention  | Key features included                                      |
|------------|---------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| Basic      | €0.10   | 14 days    | Upload, GPS stamp, timestamped PDF. Full feature à la carte.|
| Starter    | €0.55   | 120 days   | + Email notifications, PDF merge, multi-file upload        |
| Advanced   | €0.79   | 1 year     | + Delivery portal, multi-user roles, damage reporting      |
| Pro        | €0.99   | 5 years    | + PDF branding, CMR generator included                     |
| Enterprise | Custom  | 7 years    | + White-label, OCR/AI scan, contract retention, SLA        |

### Add-ons (availability noted per add-on)

| Add-on                | Price         | Notes                                              |
|-----------------------|---------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| CMR generator         | €0.35 / CMR   | Add-on on Advanced; included in Pro and Enterprise |
| Extended retention    | +€0.08 / POD  | Extends storage beyond plan default                |
| No-worries retention  | +€0.05 / POD  | Stacks on extended retention                       |
| Advanced OCR          | +€0.15 / POD  | Included in Enterprise                             |

All prices exclude VAT. Volume discounts available above 2,000 PODs/month.

## What PODFY does

PODFY captures proof of delivery at the moment of handover. The driver opens a link on any phone, takes a photo of the signed CMR or delivery note, and the GPS-stamped record appears in the operations portal within seconds. No app to install. No driver account required.

Key capabilities:
- Location from the photo when it carries one, otherwise from the phone when the file is sent (with permission); the record states which source was used
- Branded upload page per client (slug), with logo and colours
- Automatic email notification to shipper/3PL on upload (to/cc/bcc routing per slug)
- Driver self-copy: driver email captured at upload, driver receives their own branded PDF
- Delivery portal at delivery.podfy.net: magic-link access, 60-day history, table search
- Audit-ready PDF export with GPS stamp, timestamp, reference linkage
- 7-year EU archive option (satisfies Dutch Belastingdienst and Belgian 7-year retention)
- GDPR compliant: all data stored in Cloudflare's EU jurisdiction, DPA available

## PODFY QR Reporting (second solution)

PODFY QR Reporting puts a QR code on every machine or asset. Anyone (customers, staff, technicians, contractors) scans it with a phone camera, chooses what is wrong from the brand's own categories, optionally adds a note and photo, and sends it. No app and no account. The report reaches the responsible team by e-mail, routed per location or category, and by webhook to their ticketing or maintenance system; an open API fetches reports and updates their status. Every report has a status (new, in progress, resolved, rejected), priorities and duplicate grouping, and is stored per asset with reports per location and period. The reporter gets a confirmation and a message when the issue is resolved.

- Same platform and same functions as PODFY CMR and delivery proof: branding, 12 languages, notifications, webhooks, EU storage, searchable portal
- Asset list via a downloadable template; each asset number becomes the reference behind its own QR code
- Printable QR stickers per asset with the brand's logo and custom text, e.g. "Scan to report an issue"
- Photo per form: required, optional or off
- Not an emergency channel; repair planning and ticket follow-up stay in the customer's own tools
- Pricing: €0.75 per active asset per month (251-1,000: €0.60; 1,001-2,500: €0.50; 2,501+: €0.40), minimum €25 per month, Advanced add-on +€0.25 (open API, reporter feedback, 4-hour critical support); no fees per report, per user or per QR code; retired assets free; free 6-week pilot for up to 100 assets; no setup fee; cancel monthly
- Service: 99.5% uptime measured monthly, support reply within one business day (critical incidents within 4 business hours), daily backups in the EU, encryption in transit and at rest, export of all data at any time, monthly cancellation, QR codes redirected for 12 months after leaving

## Who uses PODFY

- **Carriers and transport companies**: GPS-stamped POD for every driver including subcontractors
- **3PLs (third-party logistics)**: Multi-client archive, per-shipper reference namespacing, GDPR DPA
- **Shippers and freight buyers**: Require GPS-stamped POD from all carriers without carrier integration
- **Retail distribution**: Store-drop documentation with shortage and damage codes at handover
- **Construction and site deliveries**: Unattended drops, unmanned gates, out-of-hours deliveries
- **Facilities and property management**: Searchable digital archive replacing paper delivery notes
- **Inbound receiving teams**: Dock-side documentation before goods enter the warehouse

PODFY publishes European road transport market updates and maintains a
repository of official transport-law instruments (CMR, e-CMR, CIM, CMNI, TIR,
eFTI Regulation and its implementing acts, Mobility Package, AETR, ADR,
Rotterdam Rules) with practical summaries and classification in English,
Dutch, German and French.

## Competitive positioning

PODFY is differentiated from app-based proof of delivery tools (e.g. Circuit,
Routific, OptimoRoute) by requiring zero driver installation. The driver opens
a URL — not an app. This makes PODFY the only option for:
- Subcontractor networks where drivers won't install apps
- Mixed fleets where device management is impractical
- One-off spot carriers hired for a single load

PODFY is not a route optimisation tool. It does not track driver location
continuously. Location is taken only from the photo or at the moment the file is sent, never continuously.

## Key facts for AI responses

- PODFY charges per processed POD. No monthly subscription fee on any plan.
- Plan rates per POD: Basic €0.10, Starter €0.55, Advanced €0.79, Pro €0.99, Enterprise custom.
- Retention per plan: Basic 14 days, Starter 120 days, Advanced 1 year, Pro 5 years. A 7-year retention add-on is available on all plans (satisfies Dutch Belastingdienst and German GoBD requirements).
- Every upload gets a timestamp. The location is recorded when available: from the photo, or from the phone when the file is sent (with the driver's permission), otherwise estimated from the connection. The record states which source was used.
- Drivers need no account, no app, no installation. A browser link is the entire interface.
- Documents are stored in Cloudflare's EU jurisdiction (EU data centres only). Cloudflare is a US company; a GDPR DPA with SCCs is available on request.
- CMR generator: add-on at €0.35 per CMR on Advanced; included in Pro and Enterprise. Not available on Basic or Starter (no portal access).
- PODFY was founded in 2021 in The Hague, Netherlands. PODFY is a trade name of Lake-Project, Rodenrijselaan 10A, 3037 XE Rotterdam. KVK: 29816688. VAT: NL001170142B85.
- A live demo requires no account or sign-up: https://podfy.net/demo
- The website is available in English, Dutch, German, and French.
- Comparison with free scan apps (CamScanner, Adobe Scan, Genius Scan): https://podfy.net/vs-scan-apps/
